specs.镜头: by a lever on the left side of the lens mount
specs.快门: Mirror acts like a curtain as a part of the shutter, vertical moving, due to this maximum speed is limited; speeds: 1/30-1/175 +B
specs.取景器: Waist level finder, w/ a magnifier, interchangeable with Exakta SLR pentaprism finders
specs.闪光灯: sync marks engraved on the top plate, near the speed setting ring, bulb and electronic flash icons for X and M
specs.卡口: Exakta bayonet mount, interchangeable with Exakta Varex lenses
specs.英文简介: The Exa-1 is a 35mm film SLR camera, manufactured by Ihagee Kamerawerk Steenbergen & Co, Dresden, former East Germany and produced between 1962-64.
